title: rudbeckia serotina f. dichrona
intro: Rudbeckia serotina f. dichrona, commonly known as Black-eyed Susan, is a flowering plant species native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its roots, flowers, and leaves. The health benefits of Rudbeckia serotina f. dichrona include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant, such as flavonoids and terpenoids, have been found to exhibit therapeutic actions including antioxidant, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties.
